answer: Hello! 👋 How can I help you today? You can ask about our LL.B, B.A. LL.B, admissions, facilities, or anything else related to CFI College of Law.
We offer 5-year B.A. LL.B and 3-year LL.B programs approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI).
Admissions are now open. Apply online through our website: https://cficollegeoflaw.in/admissions
Please contact our admissions team for the latest fee structure of the LL.B and B.A. LL.B programs.
For B.A. LL.B: 10+2 with minimum 45% marks. For LL.B: Graduation in any stream with at least 45% marks.
B.A. LL.B is a 5-year integrated program, while LL.B is a 3-year program.
Our syllabus includes Constitutional Law, IPC, Contract Law, Jurisprudence, Moot Court, and Legal Writing, aligned with BCI guidelines.
Students participate in internships, moot court sessions, and legal aid camps as part of their practical training.
We assist students with placements and internships at law firms, corporate houses, and courts.
Our faculty includes experienced law professionals, advocates, and academicians.
Our campus features modern classrooms, moot court hall, library, digital labs, and hostel facilities.
We have a well-equipped library with law journals, textbooks, case law digests, and online databases.
Yes, separate hostels for boys and girls are available with all basic amenities.
Scholarships are available for eligible students. Please contact the administration for details.
You can reach us at +91-8547637842 or email us at info@cficollegeoflaw.in.
CFI College of Law is located at CFI Teacher Education Campus, Poyya, Thrissur, Kerala.
Our law programs are approved by the Bar Council of India and affiliated with the University of Calicut.
Visit our official website for more info: https://cficollegeoflaw.in
